title: Allpass Filter
text: Single-section or multiple-section allpass filter, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Internal allpass structure} sets Filter structure Minimum; {Specify coefficients from input port} sets the flag to specify allpass polynomial, {Allpass polynomial coefficients} sets the coefficients in minimum multiplier form, {Wave Digital Filter allpass coefficients} sets the coefficients in wave digital filter form, {Indicate if last section is first order} sets the is last section first order, {Lattice allpass coefficients} sets the coefficients in lattice form, {View Filter Response} sets the visualize filter response and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: x
ports.summary: Input data column vector | row vector | matrix

ports.name: coeffs
ports.summary: Allpass filter coefficients column vector | row vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output of the allpass filter column vector | row vector | matrix

params.name: Internal allpass structure
params.values: Filter structure Minimum multiplier (default) | Wave Digital Filter | Lattice

params.name: Specify coefficients from input port
params.values: Flag to specify allpass polynomial coefficients off (default) | on

params.name: Allpass polynomial coefficients
params.values: Coefficients in minimum multiplier form [ -2^(-1/2), 1/2 ] (default) | N -by-1 matrix | N -by-2 matrix | N -by-4 matrix

params.name: Wave Digital Filter allpass coefficients
params.values: Coefficients in wave digital filter form [ 1/2, -2^(1/2)/3 ] (default) | N -by-1 matrix | N -by-2 matrix

params.name: Indicate if last section is first order
params.values: Is last section first order off (default) | on

params.name: Lattice allpass coefficients
params.values: Coefficients in lattice form [-2^(1/2)/3, 1/2] (default) | N -by-1 column vector | 1-by- N row vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
